flows.title: Non-contract fulfilment: PR → PO → delivery → FRN → invoice → payment
flows.notes: Chain run 2026-11-16 (PR260000000004860 → PO260000000007002 → DO 01309H005M2600503 → FN260000000005402 → SD260000000002402 → invoice → DN260000000004401). Starts from an approved RN (after dp-add-to-cart, or --input RN=…). If the PO shows Pending Partial Fulfilment, use fl-noncontract-partial-debit-note from KAT-049.

flows.title: Non-contract, partial delivery above the order: stop delivery, invoice, debit note approval
flows.notes: Memory debit-credit-note-procedure (verified 2026-11-16): services PO, delivery amount above the ordered amount; give --input PO=… of an acknowledged services PO. 2026-11-24: + DN_LOOKUP (read from FL_ADJUSTMENT) and KAT-055 payment match, so the flow ends at payment. A partial delivery leaves the PO at 41010 Pending Partial Fulfilment (no Create Invoice task) until the stop delivery instruction is approved.

flows.title: Contract fulfilment: CR → CO → delivery → FRN → invoice → payment
flows.notes: Chain 2026-10-30..11-02: CR260000000005449 → CO260000000005848 → DO 01400K003S2600002 → FN260000000005203 → IN-CO… → payment. Needs the LA of a contract with approved FD and agreement (ct-fd-agreement).
